note: The counter for the Nux machine suite: a component drawn from its .nux source alone. The three .nux files are copied from the views-slice-1 fixture folder of the parent's .nux compiler crate, each named here by its git blob id at parentCommit. The plan is the two program files; main.test.nux holds the folder's tests and is copied for provenance only, never handed to the session or compiled on the device. The plan's views are compiled on the device; nothing else is published.
